purpose: Re-run all Stage 11 reports after correcting evidence-group/list completion ranks to report the last required chunk position (not position + 1).
caveat: Legacy flat evidence lists do not define conjunction or alternative groups. Their full-list completion is diagnostic only; no current dataset has reviewer-authored evidence_groups. Image probes are self-authored development checks, not independent, blind, representative, or clinical validation.

reports.provenance: Six agent-authored development queries created after inspecting the newly ingested CC BY 4.0 2026 narrative review; four positive evidence targets and two policy negatives. The synonym-mapping negative preserves the distinction between the BTXRD class name and the canonical disease term.
